title: SANTA authds actuals (santa-authds/v1)
description: A runner's output for one authds vector file: each entry name -> a result object. The actuals file carries no kind tag, so the accept/reject asymmetry is keyed off which verdict fields are present, not off kind: an avl_prove verdict is proofs + digests (both non-null); an avl_verify verdict is proof_accepted + results (both non-null, results may be an empty array) + new_digest_hex present as a key (string or null are both legitimate values -- null means a poisoned verifier, not an absent field). error null => a verdict was produced (at least one of the two shapes above, the union shape with the other kind's fields present-and-null is legal); any non-null error forces every verdict field (proofs, digests, proof_accepted, results, new_digest_hex), if present, to null. error == 'panicked' requires note; forbidden otherwise.

note.description: Panic message/class. Present iff error == 'panicked'; forbidden otherwise.

allOf.$comment: error null => a verdict was produced. avl_prove shape: proofs AND digests both present and non-null. avl_verify shape: proof_accepted AND results both present and non-null (results may be an empty array) AND new_digest_hex present as a key (string or null are both legitimate values). Keyed off which fields are present since actuals rows carry no kind tag; the union shape (other kind's fields present-and-null) is still legal.
error non-null => every verdict field (proofs, digests, proof_accepted, results, new_digest_hex), if present, must be null.
note present iff error is 'panicked'; forbidden otherwise.
